mission: Read-only diagnostic yuyu-f1-parallel-check (owner question 2026-10-20 06:41Z on F1 batch-2 sample row 8, OP14-118): lists every print and every stored Yuyu-Tei listing of OP14-118 in any release, category or status, and for every pending F1 proposal counts same-kind prints and listings of the card code across all releases plus prints or listings the F1 rule cannot type, to find a second parallel (manga, super or reprint parallel) the same-release rule could miss. Staging only; no write, collector, rollout, migration, source request, price, identity, mapping, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change.

impacts.reason: New named read-only diagnostic (SELECT/WITH only, run under default_transaction_read_only=on by db-diagnostic). Listing and print kinds mirror source_mapping_proposals.yuyu_listing_kind and print_listing_kind; the F1 rule itself is unchanged.
Adds yuyu-f1-parallel-check to the diagnostic choice list. No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

impact.deployment_impact: No API, worker or collector code changes and nothing deploys; 0 collector rollouts, no DDL.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the diagnostic. Nothing is written by it.
recovery.trigger: The diagnostic errors or a read takes locks it should not.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no write.

verification.observation_window: After merge: db-diagnostic yuyu-f1-parallel-check returns OP14-118 prints and listings and the F1 multi-parallel counts. F1 batch-2 apply waits on its answer and the owner's go.
